title: Ribes NDE 919
content:
I was asleep, under anesthesia, then I was projected in a bright tunnel at a dizzying speed; some colors, some flashes of light. Then, a slowdown, I was out of the tunnel. I was floating in the air and I went forward; I heard divine music and a voice, which talked to me as if it were within myself. It was a soft and reassuring voice, which told me not to be afraid, and that I didn’t risk anything, which reassured me. At the same time, I was bathed in divine music; I didn’t feel anything, neither my heart beat, nor my body nor my body’s gravity. I was looking at my body: I didn’t have a body anymore. I got closer to a light that is more and more intense. Nevertheless, I didn’t have any pain in my eyes. I was able to distinguish three white silhouettes in the light, from the shoulders to the head. Being at just two or three meters (six and half to ten feet) away from them, I didn’t go forward any further. Those three beings were fascinating; a kindness emanated from them; I had no fear. Their large and black eyes, all black and globulous, almond-shaped eyes expressed compassion. The voice went on: it told me that it is not my turn and that I would start again. Then a great white light; I opened my eyes and the doctors succeeded in resuscitating me. My father told me, ‘you made us frightened’. Later on, I told my mother that I saw three angels.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt no heartbeat, no body, and no gravity; was floating.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Projected in a bright tunnel at a dizzying speed; then a slowdown.

arrival.other_being_detail: Three white silhouettes in the light (shoulders to head), with large black globulous almond-shaped eyes; kindness and compassion emanated from them. Experiencer later told mother they were 'three angels.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Some colors and flashes of light in/around the tunnel; light becoming more and more intense; divine music.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After the voice said it was not his turn and he would 'start again,' there was a great white light; he opened his eyes and doctors resuscitated him.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Divine music; three white silhouettes/angels; stopped 2–3 meters away and did not go further.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE elements (floating/no body) are described after the tunnel exit; communication and music occur while floating and approaching the light.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Divine music and an inner voice occurred while floating/moving forward and approaching the intensifying light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Three beings described as white silhouettes with large black globulous almond-shaped eyes; divine music throughout.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was a soft and reassuring voice, which told me not to be afraid, and that I didn’t risk anything.” / “It is not my turn and that I would start again.” / “Later on, I told my mother that I saw three angels.” / Father: “you made us frightened”.
